scope: Review one primitive-recognition boundary for an explicit axis-aligned rectangular prism.

checks.name: single_purpose
checks.notes: The operation emits one primitive parameter contract and does not choose a construction method.

checks.name: case_neutral
checks.notes: Dimensions, body names, source paths, and run paths are inputs rather than template constants.

checks.name: ambiguity_gate
checks.notes: Missing extents, units, orientation, or additional features prevent a ready handoff.

checks.name: evidence_boundary
checks.notes: Host checks validate declarations and derivations only, not the correctness of source interpretation.

notes: This is a design record for a candidate operation, not source-interpretation or application evidence.
